segments.text: Hello guys welcome back to my youtube channel Safety Management Study
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到我的 YouTube 频道 Safety Management Study。

segments.text: Guys today's video is about TLB, TWA, HTEL, IDLH
segments.zh: 各位，今天的视频讲的是 TLV、TWA、STEL、IDLH。

segments.text: Today we will learn about TLB, TWA, HTEL, IDLH
segments.zh: 今天我们来了解 TLV、TWA、STEL、IDLH。

segments.text: So let's start today's video
segments.zh: 那么我们开始今天的视频吧。

segments.text: TLB i.e threshold limit value
segments.zh: TLV，即阈限值。

segments.text: What is threshold limit value?
segments.zh: 什么是阈限值？

segments.text: So here is the definition
segments.zh: 这里是定义：

segments.text: The concentration of HTEL in the air
segments.zh: 空气中有害物质的浓度，

segments.text: in which worker can be exposed day after day for a working lifetime
segments.zh: 工人在整个职业生涯中日复一日地暴露于该浓度下，

segments.text: without adverse long-term or short-term health effect
segments.zh: 不会产生长期或短期的不良健康影响。

segments.text: i.e. in the air, the concentration of HTEL is so much
segments.zh: 也就是说，空气中有害物质的浓度达到这样的程度：

segments.text: that if the worker works his whole working life
segments.zh: 工人即使在其中工作整个职业生涯，

segments.text: then the long-term or short-term adverse health effect will not happen
segments.zh: 也不会出现长期或短期的不良健康影响。

segments.text: Any gas, chemical or toxic substance's concentration
segments.zh: 任何气体、化学品或有毒物质的浓度

segments.text: is so much that the worker works his whole work life
segments.zh: 达到这样的程度：工人在其中工作整个职业生涯，

segments.text: without any adverse health effect
segments.zh: 也不会产生任何不良健康影响，

segments.text: So the concentration of that chemical will be TLB
segments.zh: 那么这种化学品的这个浓度就是 TLV。

segments.text: Next, TWA, Time Weightage Average
segments.zh: 接下来，TWA，时间加权平均值。

segments.text: So let's learn about TWA
segments.zh: 我们来了解一下 TWA。

segments.text: The concentration of contaminant in the air
segments.zh: 空气中污染物的浓度，

segments.text: in which workers can be exposed for 8 hours and 40 hours in a week
segments.zh: 工人在该浓度下每天暴露 8 小时、每周 40 小时，

segments.text: without adverse long-term or short-term health effect
segments.zh: 不会产生长期或短期的不良健康影响。

segments.text: i.e. in the air, the amount of contaminant and toxic substance
segments.zh: 也就是说，空气中污染物和有毒物质的含量

segments.text: is so much that the worker works for 8 hours per day
segments.zh: 达到这样的程度：工人每天工作 8 小时、

segments.text: and 40 hours in a week
segments.zh: 每周工作 40 小时，

segments.text: and if he is exposed then there will be no adverse health effect
segments.zh: 即使暴露其中也不会产生不良健康影响。

segments.text: i.e. any gas or chemical
segments.zh: 也就是说，任何气体或化学品，

segments.text: concentration in which the worker can work 8 hours a day
segments.zh: 工人在该浓度下可以每天工作 8 小时、

segments.text: and 40 hours in a week without any health effect
segments.zh: 每周工作 40 小时而不受任何健康影响，

segments.text: we will talk about TWA of that chemical
segments.zh: 我们就说这是该化学品的 TWA。

segments.text: i.e. if there is only 10 ppm of H2S in an environment
segments.zh: 也就是说，如果某个环境中 H2S 只有 10 ppm，

segments.text: then any worker can work 8 hours in a day and 40 hours in a week
segments.zh: 那么任何工人都可以每天工作 8 小时、每周工作 40 小时，

segments.text: without any adverse health effect
segments.zh: 而不会产生任何不良健康影响，

segments.text: there will be no adverse effect and no damage
segments.zh: 不会有不良影响，也不会有损害。

segments.text: So the 10 ppm of H2S is the TWA of that chemical
segments.zh: 所以 H2S 的 10 ppm 就是这种化学品的 TWA。

segments.text: Next, STEL i.e. short-term exposure limit
segments.zh: 接下来，STEL，即短时间接触限值。

segments.text: What is the short-term exposure limit?
segments.zh: 什么是短时间接触限值？

segments.text: The minimum concentration of a chemical at which workers can be exposed
segments.zh: 化学品的最低浓度，工人在该浓度下暴露

segments.text: for up to 15 minutes without adverse long-term or short-term health effect
segments.zh: 最长 15 分钟，不会产生长期或短期的不良健康影响。

segments.text: i.e. any toxic gas or chemical
segments.zh: 也就是说，任何有毒气体或化学品，

segments.text: concentration in which the worker can work for 15 minutes
segments.zh: 工人在该浓度下可以工作 15 分钟

segments.text: without any adverse health effect
segments.zh: 而不会产生任何不良健康影响，

segments.text: i.e. if the worker is working for 15 minutes
segments.zh: 也就是说，如果工人工作 15 分钟，

segments.text: there will be no effect of that chemical
segments.zh: 这种化学品不会对他产生影响，

segments.text: then that chemical will be called STEL
segments.zh: 那么这种化学品的这个浓度就称为 STEL。

segments.text: The STEL of H2S is 15 ppm
segments.zh: H2S 的 STEL 是 15 ppm。

segments.text: If there is 15 ppm in any environment
segments.zh: 如果某个环境中是 15 ppm，

segments.text: then you can work for 15 minutes
segments.zh: 那么你可以工作 15 分钟，

segments.text: without any adverse health effect
segments.zh: 而不会产生任何不良健康影响。

segments.text: Next, IDLH i.e. immediately dangerous to life and health
segments.zh: 接下来，IDLH，即立即威胁生命和健康。

segments.text: So what is IDLH?
segments.zh: 那么什么是 IDLH？

segments.text: The concentration of chemical or airborne contaminants
segments.zh: 化学品或空气中污染物的浓度，

segments.text: at which if worker will be exposed
segments.zh: 工人一旦暴露于该浓度下，

segments.text: then it will pose an immediate threat to life
segments.zh: 就会对生命构成直接威胁。

segments.text: i.e. any chemical or airborne contaminants
segments.zh: 也就是说，任何化学品或空气中污染物，

segments.text: the concentration in which the worker is exposed
segments.zh: 工人暴露于该浓度下，

segments.text: if the worker works then his life can be damaged immediately
segments.zh: 如果工人在其中工作，他的生命会立即受到危害，

segments.text: even death can happen
segments.zh: 甚至可能死亡。

segments.text: i.e. workers in this condition
segments.zh: 也就是说，在这种条件下，工人

segments.text: do not have to work in that environment
segments.zh: 不应在该环境中工作。

segments.text: The IDLH of H2S is 100 ppm
segments.zh: H2S 的 IDLH 是 100 ppm。

segments.text: If in any environment
segments.zh: 如果在任何环境中

segments.text: the IDLH of H2S is 100 ppm
segments.zh: H2S 达到 IDLH 的 100 ppm，

segments.text: then they cannot work there
segments.zh: 那么他们就不能在那里工作，

segments.text: suddenly someone's death can happen
segments.zh: 可能会有人突然死亡，

segments.text: and anyone's life can be damaged
segments.zh: 任何人的生命都可能受到危害。

segments.text: I hope you understood what is TLB, TWA, STEL, IDLH
segments.zh: 希望你已经理解了什么是 TLV、TWA、STEL、IDLH。

segments.text: If you understood then like the video
segments.zh: 如果你理解了，请给视频点赞，

segments.text: subscribe to the channel
segments.zh: 并订阅频道。

segments.text: thank you for watching
segments.zh: 感谢观看。
